answer: Payout audit: a reward of x times the median payout is audited with probability min(1, x/4), and a failed audit burns 3 times the reward. Umber is the linear band from 0 to 4 times median, so x = 2 draws a 50 percent audit. Pearl is any payout at 4 times median or above, audited every time. Relic is the audit receipt kept for 10 epochs so a lost audit can be replayed. Failure mode: splitting one reward over 8 wallets to stay near 0.5 times median. Check rule: probability uses the summed payout of a funding tree. Cheapest bypass: separate trees via exchanges unless funding analysis links them.
